title: When Should Agents Remember? Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.14326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, verifier-rich environments, but current self-improvement mechanisms often write episode-derived lessons directly into memory, making local success an unreliable signal for reusable and safe knowledge. This paper addresses the core question of when an experience-derived behavioral update should be admitted into persistent agent state. We propose Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution (FGSE), a verifier-grounded framework that represents each candidate lesson as a structured hypothesis with an explicit precondition, behavior change, expected effect, and verifier. FGSE applies the hypothesis only in a temporary state, tests it on target-transfer, falsification, and archived-regression probes, and then commits, refines, or rejects it according to measured gain and risk. Across web, app, tool-use, and long-term memory benchmarks, FGSE achieves strong task performance, including 39.8 WebArena succes

translated_title: 智能体何时应该记忆？面向LLM智能体的证伪门控自我进化
translated_abstract: LLM智能体日益运行在长时程、验证器丰富的环境中，但当前的自我改进机制往往将回合经验中总结的教训直接写入记忆，使得局部成功成为可复用且安全知识的不可靠信号。本文解决的核心问题是：何时应将来自经验的 行为更新纳入智能体的持久状态。我们提出证伪门控自我进化（FGSE），这是一个以验证器为基础的框架，将每个候选经验教训表示为结构化假设，包含明确的前提条件、行为改变、预期效果和验证器。FGSE仅在临时状态中应用该假设，在目标迁移、证伪和归档回归探测上进行测试，然后根据测得的收益和风险来提交、细化或拒绝该假设。在网页、应用、工具使用和长期记忆基准测试中，FGSE取得了强大的任务性能，包括39.8的WebArena成功率。
tldr: 提出证伪门控自我进化（FGSE）框架，将经验教训表示为结构化假设，仅在临时状态中经受证伪、迁移与回归探测，只有通过收益与风险双重验证的行为更新才被写入智能体的持久记忆，从而显著提升LLM智能体自我进化的可靠性与安全性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Falsification-Gated Self-Evolution (FGSE), a verifier-grounded framework that represents experience-derived lessons as structured hypotheses tested through falsification, transfer, and regression probes in temporary states, committing only gain-and-risk-validated updates into persistent agent memory for safer and more reliable LLM agent self-evolution.
